name: The Giant Turtle Carrying a Forest on its Shell
description: An ancient, wise giant sea turtle swimming through a starry cosmic sky, with a lush, green forest, tiny mountains, and a flowing waterfall on its massive shell.
prompt: A colossal, ancient sea turtle with a detailed, patterned shell swimming slowly through a starry, cosmic sky filled with nebulae. On its shell grows a lush, miniature ecosystem: green forests, tiny rolling hills, a small flowing waterfall, and soft glowing plants. The turtle has a wise, serene expression, with glowing eyes. Cosmic fantasy, highly detailed, majestic.
caption: The ancient wanderer of the cosmos, carrying a whole living world on its wise, slow back. 🐢✨
